sourceFingerprintAlgorithm: sha256 over the covered paths in DECLARED ORDER; each path contributes <repo-relative path> NUL <64-hex sha256 of the file's RAW BYTES> NUL; per-file digest = script/m24/portability.ts sha256File() (node:crypto, no process spawn)
laws: R0 fixture truth from the REAL indexer (seed can never drift)
R1 component: member roots at the owner, resolution declared
R2 unknown symbol keeps the declared error
R3 a member with its own edges does not re-root
R4 renderer states the resolution; direct renders no note
R5 real server end to end (the owner-session defect fixed)
R6 four mutants (fallback dropped, rule-3 broken, silent relabel, note hidden)
limitations: The fallback requires an exact single-name member match and a traversable owner; ambiguous names keep the declared error (documented narrowness, never a guess).
Cross-file owners resolve the same way (owner_symbol_id is workspace-global); the fixture covers the same-file shape the owner session exercised.
